name: Panic
use_when: Use when fear should make people do stupid, desperate things under pressure (slasher, survival, a ship with something aboard).

thresholds.note: Jitters: a small panic, played now
Panic: the character loses control for a moment, played now

jitters: drops something that matters: a light, a key, the only map
a gasp or a shout gives away where they are
shakes so hard the next fine task is -1
snaps at a friend: the bond is strained until they make it right
fixes on one exit and will not hear any other plan
freezes for a heartbeat: the danger gets one step closer
panic: runs, alone, in a direction of the GM's choosing
fires, swings or throws at the first thing that moves
hides and will not come out until someone talks them out
grabs whatever might save them and will not share it
shuts down: sits where they are, eyes open, gone for the scene unless carried
